"""核对第64轮文档链接、索引可达性及独立代码变更记录。"""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
data = root / 'knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm'
output = data / 'v67-document-check.json'
assert not output.exists()
documents = sorted({root / 'AGENTS.md', root / 'readme.md', root / 'benchmarks/readme.md'} |
                   set((root / 'knowledge').rglob('*.md')) | set((root / 'changelog').glob('*.md')))
edges = {p.resolve(): set() for p in documents}
broken, links = [], 0
for path in documents:
    for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]\n]*\]\(([^)\n]+)\)', path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')):
        target = target.strip().strip('<>')
        if re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*://', target) or target.startswith(('#', 'mailto:')):
            continue
        destination = (path.parent / unquote(target.split('#', 1)[0])).resolve()
        links += 1
        if not destination.exists() and destination != output:
            broken.append({'source': path.relative_to(root).as_posix(), 'target': target})
        if destination in edges:
            edges[path.resolve()].add(destination)
reachable, todo = set(), [(root / 'readme.md').resolve()]
while todo:
    node = todo.pop()
    if node not in reachable:
        reachable.add(node)
        todo.extend(edges.get(node, set()) - reachable)
targets = set()
for date in ('2026-10-23', '2026-10-24'):
    changelog = root / ('changelog/' + date + '.md')
    text = changelog.read_text(encoding='utf-8').split('\n## v67', 1)[1]
    targets.update((changelog.parent / unquote(t.strip().strip('<>').split('#', 1)[0])).resolve()
                   for t in re.findall(r'\[[^\]\n]*\]\(([^)\n]+)\)', text)
                   if not re.match(r'^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*://', t))
names = ['v67-plan.json', 'v67-baseline-check.json', 'v67-runner-self-check-attempt1.json',
         'v67-build.py', 'v67-krylov-diagnostic.hpp', 'v67-krylov-instrumentation.py',
         'v67-krylov-self-test.cpp', 'v67-run.py', 'v67-analyze.py',
         'v67-assembly-probe.json', 'v67-verification-attempt1.json',
         'v67-archive-manifest.json', 'v67-document-check.json']
coverage = {name: (data / name).resolve() in targets for name in names}
unreachable = [p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in documents if p.resolve() not in reachable]
source = Path(__file__).read_bytes()
result = {'passed': not broken and not unreachable and all(coverage.values()),
          'created_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'documents': len(documents), 'local_links': links, 'broken_links': broken,
          'unreachable_documents': unreachable, 'round64_changelog_coverage': coverage,
          'source': source.decode('utf-8'), 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
          'document_sha256': {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in documents}}
with output.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({k: result[k] for k in ('passed', 'documents', 'local_links', 'broken_links',
                                     'unreachable_documents', 'round64_changelog_coverage')}, ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(0 if result['passed'] else 1)

"""保留第64轮每次调用的真实开始时间、退出、原始输出和执行源码。"""
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = ROOT / 'knowledge/experiments/data/2026-10-12-halpern-ipm'
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('label')
parser.add_argument('script')
parser.add_argument('arguments', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
args = parser.parse_args()
assert args.label.startswith('v67-') and '/' not in args.label and '\\' not in args.label
target = DATA / (args.label + '.json')
assert not target.exists()
script = (ROOT / args.script).resolve()
assert script.is_relative_to(ROOT) and script.is_file()
source = script.read_bytes()
command = [sys.executable, str(script), *args.arguments]
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
begin = time.perf_counter()
process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=dict(os.environ, PYTHONUTF8='1'), capture_output=True)
record = {
    'started_at_utc': started,
    'completed_at_utc': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'command': command, 'returncode': process.returncode, 'elapsed_seconds': time.perf_counter()-begin,
    'source': source.decode('utf-8'), 'source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest(),
    'stdout': process.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'),
    'stderr': process.stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'),
    'wrapper_source': Path(__file__).read_bytes().decode('utf-8'),
    'wrapper_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
}
with target.open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(record, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    f.write('\n')
if process.returncode == 0 and args.arguments in (['self-test'], ['--self-test']) and script.name == 'v67-run.py':
    result = json.loads(record['stdout'])
    assert result['passed'] is True and result['lp_runs'] == 0
    with (DATA / 'v67-runner-self-check.json').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(result, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'record': str(target), 'returncode': record['returncode'],
                  'elapsed_seconds': record['elapsed_seconds']}, ensure_ascii=False))
print(record['stdout'][-4000:])
if record['stderr']:
    print(record['stderr'][-4000:])
raise SystemExit(process.returncode)
